vb_textbox.text: Left vs Right (S vs K) had no difference i could see. the previous person to me recommended colours (brown and green) that were for me the weakest (purple and red strongest for me) so i recommend picking one of each 4 at the start and sticking to the highest selection for most of the game (more on this down below). sometimes those highest ones will drop off a bit and begin to give 1, 2 or 4 but i found switching to the other colour didn't give better results. some time later though near what felt like the end my initial selection gave only low or 0 and then i did switch to the other colour and that helped. watch out for getting brain tired near the end and not hitting space bar quick enough from the repetitive action. good luck! :-)
